exam-from-samples.title: Practice exam — Contract Law
exam-from-samples.instructions: Duration: 3 hours. Allowed material: statute book only. Answer all questions and explain, with reference to legislation and case law.
exam-from-samples.style_notes: As in past exams: two fact-pattern questions, 50 points each. Graders look for identifying the issues, a precise rule, and application to both sides.

questions.prompt: Ron emailed Galit: "I'll sell you my car for ₪40,000; the offer is open until Thursday". On Wednesday Galit replied: "I accept, on condition that you replace the tires". On Thursday morning she wrote: "Forget the tires, I accept". Ron refuses. Discuss.

rubric.criterion: Identifying the offer and examining intent and definiteness (s. 2)
The status of Thursday's message and a reasoned conclusion

questions.model_answer: The email is an offer (intent and definiteness). An acceptance with a material condition is a counter-offer and rejects the original offer; Thursday's message is a new offer, not an acceptance, so no contract was made.

questions.prompt: A supplier undertook to deliver equipment to an event hall by June 1 and didn't. The hall cancelled two events. May the hall rescind the contract immediately? What damages is it entitled to?

rubric.criterion: Classifying the breach as fundamental or not, and the effect on rescission (s. 7)

questions.model_answer: If the delivery date is essential, the breach is fundamental and the hall may rescind immediately; otherwise extra time is required. Damages cover harm the supplier foresaw or should have foreseen, such as cancelled events.
